name: paprcraft-lambda
comment: Each Lambda is zipped from a few files here. The AWS SDK comes with the Node runtime, so it's a devDependency (tests) only. First-time creation of each function is done by backend/infra (20-audit-trail.sh, 29-docx-template.sh); these scripts redeploy code. Add new Lambdas as compile-/update-/deploy- script triples.

scripts.update-audit-trail-stg: aws lambda update-function-code --profile paprcraft-dev-loy --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name paprcraft-stg-audit-trail --zip-file fileb://audit-trail.zip
scripts.update-audit-trail-prod: aws lambda update-function-code --profile paprcraft-dev-loy --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name paprcraft-prod-audit-trail --zip-file fileb://audit-trail.zip
scripts.deploy-audit-trail-stg: yarn compile-audit-trail && yarn update-audit-trail-stg && rm -f audit-trail.zip
scripts.deploy-audit-trail-prod: yarn compile-audit-trail && yarn update-audit-trail-prod && rm -f audit-trail.zip
scripts.update-docx-template-stg: aws lambda update-function-code --profile paprcraft-dev-loy --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name paprcraft-stg-docx-template --zip-file fileb://docx-template.zip
scripts.update-docx-template-prod: aws lambda update-function-code --profile paprcraft-dev-loy --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name paprcraft-prod-docx-template --zip-file fileb://docx-template.zip
scripts.deploy-docx-template-stg: yarn compile-docx-template && yarn update-docx-template-stg && rm -f docx-template.zip
scripts.deploy-docx-template-prod: yarn compile-docx-template && yarn update-docx-template-prod && rm -f docx-template.zip
